items.subject: London Borough of Bexley is hiring a Housing Resettlement Officer
items.summary: New vacancies include Housing Resettlement Officer at Bexley and Planning Policy Support Officer at the Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government; a Greenwich role was previously reported.
items.action: Review the Bexley and Ministry of Housing roles first, then decide whether either is worth applying for.
items.decisionNeeded: Whether to apply for the Bexley or Ministry of Housing role.
